第28章 不择手段地活下去-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

许默战靴猛踏出。

他并未顺势后退，反而腰身一拧，整个人向侧后方疾退而去。

那种深陷泥沼的【迟滞】感依旧如影随形，但他这精妙的横向扯动，却巧妙地利用了周围粗壮的树根与岩石，强行制造出一个狭窄的漏斗口。

原本呈扇形包围过来的十一只蜘蛛，此刻能够同时面对他的，仅仅只剩下五只。

幽暗的林间空地上，【黑曜石战刃】的锋刃猛然扬起，拉出一道夸张而致命的半月弧光。

撕裂声几乎重叠在一起。

蓝阶武器高达三十点的恐怖战力，在这一刻展现得淋漓尽致。

坚韧的毒蛛甲壳在黑曜石面前犹如湿透的草纸，三只壮硕的蜘蛛在半空中被拦腰斩成两截，紫黑色的腥臭脏器稀里哗啦地砸落一地。

剩下的两只毒蛛已然扑至身侧，狰狞的口器甚至能滴下散发着甜腻气息的毒液。

许默不闪不避，左肩下沉。

盾牌狠狠撞向左侧毒蛛的节肢。

骨骼断裂声响起，两只毒蛛被这股蛮力硬生生撞得失去平衡，向后翻仰。

战刃去势未竭，许默借着撞击的反冲力悍然回旋腰身，锋利的刃口带着死神般的呼啸反扫而回。

两颗长满复眼的丑陋头颅冲天而起，绿色的血泉喷涌而出。

最后一只彻底发狂的毒蛛从死角高高跃起，八根利爪直指许默的面门。

一支震颤的箭精准无误地从斜上方射来，顺着它大张的口器狠狠贯入，将其死死钉在地面的腐殖土上。

毒蛛的节肢疯狂抽搐了几下，彻底僵死。

头尾不过数息的碰撞，十一只狂暴的怪物尽数伏诛。

许默胸膛微微起伏，快速扫视了一圈自己的胸甲与护腿。

完美无伤。

数据开始跳动。

【获得：蜘蛛毒液×2】

【获得：蜘蛛腺体（绿色）×2】

他用刀尖挑开一具怪物的甲壳，露出里面泛着紫黑色泽的诡异肉块。

【食物·怪物肉】

【品质：绿色】

Xu Mo stepped out with his combat boots.

Instead of retreating, he twisted his waist and retreated to the side and back.

The "sluggish" feeling of being stuck in a mire was still with him, but his exquisite horizontal pulling skillfully used the thick tree roots and rocks around him to forcefully create a narrow funnel mouth.

Of the eleven spiders that were originally surrounded in a fan shape, only five were able to face him at the same time.

In the dark forest clearing, the blade of the [Obsidian War Blade] suddenly raised, pulling out an exaggerated and deadly half-moon arc.

The tearing sounds almost overlapped.

The terrifying combat power of blue-level weapons, which can reach 30 points, was fully demonstrated at this moment.

The tough poisonous spider carapace was like wet straw paper in front of the obsidian. The three sturdy spiders were chopped into two pieces in mid-air, and the purple-black fishy organs were smashed to the ground with a clatter.

The remaining two poisonous spiders have already rushed to the side, and their ferocious mouthparts can even drip venom that exudes a sweet smell.

Xu Mo did not dodge or dodge, his left shoulder sank.

The shield slammed into the arthropod of the poisonous spider on the left side.

There was a sound of bones breaking, and the two poisonous spiders were knocked off balance by this brute force and rolled backwards.

The war blade had not yet exhausted its power. Xu Mo used the recoil of the impact to spin his waist, and the sharp blade swept back with a death-like roar.

Two ugly heads with compound eyes soared into the sky, and green blood fountains gush out.

The last completely crazy poisonous spider jumped up from the blind corner, its eight sharp claws pointing directly at Xu Mo's face.

A trembling arrow was accurately shot from above, piercing its wide-open mouthparts and pinning it to the humus on the ground.

The poisonous spider's jointed limbs twitched wildly several times, and it was completely stiff.

In just a few breaths of head-to-tail collision, all eleven violent monsters were killed.

Xu Mo's chest rose and fell slightly, and he quickly glanced around at his breastplate and leggings.

Perfect and no damage.

The data starts to jump.

[Get: Spider Venom × 2]

[Obtain: Spider gland (green) × 2]

He used the tip of the knife to open the carapace of a monster, revealing the strange purple-black flesh inside.
